data.evidence: Search 'ContiTech' (2026-08-29) returned no self-hosted careers page and no clear 'ContiTech' interview/process pages. Continental AG (the parent) is a well-known German automotive/tire group; ContiTech (Continental Addingham Ltd in the UK) is one of its industrial rubber/composite divisions. The Bengaluru role sits under 'Continental Industry' LinkedIn entity (same as the company field on the lead). Verdict: employer is real and verifiable as a division of Continental AG; no separate ContiTech job board page was found — LinkedIn is the primary channel.
